They didn't use flyback transformers to generate the tube anode voltage or B+ supply so you should have a voltage multiplier section that is usually a separate module that is potted in epoxy to protect from high voltage and arcing. I would also look at the tubes to make sure all them glow after being warmed up for a few minutes. If you have any tube filaments burned out or there are any tubes that look silvered all over (a spot is okay but not total coverage) then you would need to replace them.
